## 专业目录覆盖记录

**已完成所列官方目录范围的对账**，共 84 项；这不是全字段详情的完成状态。

<p><strong>统计范围：</strong>Central bachelor-level programmes, Dauphine L1 gateways and L3 specialisations, College L2 double majors and L3 specialisations, ENSAD ten artistic sectors.</p>

<p><strong>对账方法：</strong>All 7 central catalogue pages (0–6) read; 16 Licence cards followed to individual pages. Dauphine public finder API pages1–4 yielded exactly34 cards and all34 programme pages read. College one-page official diagram visually checked:5 L1 paths /12 unique L3 specialisations. Central 2026/27 PDF read; current site additionally lists Professorat des Ecoles.</p>

<p><strong>排除项：</strong>Only central Licence/grade de licence scope and undergraduate internal fields. Dauphine repetitive L2 curriculum stages and repeated IA double-licence year pages excluded; first Magistère year retained as L3 grade de licence, not entire graduate Magistère. MSc/engineering diplomas explicitly classed master excluded. Original French titles retained in name_en rather than invented English translations.</p>

**尚未解决的目录缺口：**

- Full award-to-specialisation compatibility is source-dependent; College diagram prerequisites are not represented as automatic eligibility. Members’ master-level ENS/engineering diplomas do not imply additional bachelor awards.
- Two Tunis search cards label L1 while their linked pages identify L2 and L3. The L2 card is excluded as a repeated stage, and L3 identity follows the actual programme page.
- Current central and 2026/27 PDF differ because the current site has Professorat des Ecoles and separately lists two CPES entry groupings. Both sources retained; no blanket assumption of 2027 recruitment.
